label: No being other than an actual root is required by that root's own end
paraphrase: OPEN (SS, analyst formulation, unattributed): for every actual root n of the selected grounding relation G at w and every being x other than n, x is not required by n's own end (EndRequires, read as the teleological means-to-end relation). The self-sufficiency of the root's good: on Aquinas's account the divine goodness is complete without other things (ST I q.19 a.3 co., paraphrase, navigation only). On the rejected strict-modal reading of EndRequires (x exists wherever y does), every necessary being would be required and SS with a common root alone would yield NAR (controls, law 6), begging the question; SS is asserted only on the means-to-end reading.
